subtitle.en: An island snapshot from two angles, plus a week of touch controls and a week of rewriting the panel line-tracing code.
subtitle.zh: 两个角度的岛屿快照，外加一周触控操作、一周重写面板连线代码。

blocks.en: ... which doesn't look too much different from last time's. Partially this is because we've been working on things that you don't see from this angle.
blocks.zh: ……它跟上一次那张看起来没太大区别。部分原因是我们一直在做从这个角度看不到的东西。

blocks.en: Here's a shot from a different angle:
blocks.zh: 下面是从另一个角度拍的：

blocks.en: We still have so much to do!

On my end, I've been working for the past couple of weeks on UI-related things. For a week I was doing better touch controls (perhaps we'll post a video of this soon), and for a week I was somewhat-rewriting the code that implements tracing lines on panels. This can get surprisingly complicated, and I've rewritten it a few times. I think this is close to the last time, though.
blocks.zh: 我这边，过去几周一直在做和 UI 相关的东西。有一周在做更好的触控操作（也许我们很快会发一段演示视频），还有一周在某种程度上重写「在面板上描绘连线」的代码。这东西会变得出乎意料地复杂，我已经重写过几次了。不过我觉得这次差不多是最后一次了。

blocks.en: The game tells me the current puzzle count is 574, which is higher than I expected, but hey.
blocks.zh: 游戏告诉我目前的谜题数量是 574 个，比我预想的要多，不过，管他呢。
